I replied to Marcus in a thread on his message in #north-team: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 25 November.

That date comes only from Ilse's post in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing in the channel has changed it since. There's no account file for Brackenwater I could check it against, so if he needs a written source for the sheet, Ilse's message is it.
